# Account Balance Quick View for DeepSeek Harness
A quick balance viewer for DeepSeek Harness — good news for the balance-anxious. The sidebar badge a
lso shows the current official pricing period (peak / off-peak) without opening anything; click it f
or balance, bonus credit, current model, next price switch and the platform usage shortcut. Low bala
nces are highlighted.

> Formerly a context-usage widget. The Harness now renders its own context meter
> below the compose

r and token-usage pills in the composer dock, so this widget
> focuses on account information instea
d of repeating those readings.

> **Personal share.** Built for my own use and released as-is — if something is
> off, please be pat

ient; issues and suggestions are welcome. The gemstone tiers
> are there so checking the balance fee
ls a little more VIP.
## Screenshots
> The icon uses the DeepSeek Harness brand whale mark (a Harness plugin borrowing the Harness brand
n uses the DeepSeek Harness brand whale mark (a Harness plugin borrowing the Harness brand artwork).
## What it shows
- **Sidebar badge** — the whale mark plus the current balance next to the settings button (in the na
rrow rail only the whale). The whale and amount are rendered with balance-tier textures: ruby (<10),

amber (10–29.99), jade (30–99.99), metallic gold (>=100).
- **Popover** — click the badge for:
- ba

lance (large),
- a low-balance warning when below 10,
- bonus credit,
- current model,
- a shortcut

to the platform usage page.
- **Live** — balance is refreshed when the popover opens and every 60 se

conds.
- **Pricing period** — the sidebar shows `高峰` (peak) or `空闲` (off-peak) in Beijing time, foll
owing the official Models & Pricing rules; the host re-syncs the public pricing page daily and retri
es hourly on failure. Peak hours are Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, excluding Chine
se public holidays; weekends and holidays are off-peak. The popover shows the next switch and the la

st official sync date.
- **Theme-aware** — colors follow the active DSH theme; readable in light and

dark modes.
- **Safe by design** — every optional service is error-isolated; a failure shows a dash
instead of blocking DSH.
## Balance textures
The whale icon, the sidebar amount and the popover balance use gemstone/metal textures by primary wa
llet amount (CNY, then USD, then the first wallet):
| Amount | Texture |

| below 10 | ruby (dark rim, jewel red, light window) |
| 10 – 29.99 | amber / citrine |
| 30 – 99.9

9 | jade |
| 100 and above | metallic gold (multi-band reflections, subtle 5 s sheen) |
Below 10 the panel also shows a `Low balance` warning. Thresholds are hardcoded in `client.js` (`bal
e panel also shows a `Low balance` warning. Thresholds are hardcoded in `client.js` (`balanceTier`).
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0` (Web client).
- Sign in to a DeepSeek account to see balance and bonus
credit. Without an account the badge shows a dash.
## Install
From the plugin manager: **Settings → Plugins**, install the package `@mark.zy/usage-widget`.
For a local source checkout, install the bundle with the plugin manager and point it at this directo
ry (`install_bundle`, target = this folder's absolute path).
After installing or updating, **quit DSH completely and reopen it** — client plugins load at startup
, a page refresh is not enough.
## Usage

1. The badge sits at the bottom of the sidebar, next to the settings button.
2. Click it to open the

account panel; click anywhere outside to close it.
3. The platform usage link opens the DeepSeek pl
atform usage page in a new tab.
## Data sources & privacy
| Data | Source | Notes |
| Balance / bonus credit | DSH's built-in account service (`remote.account.getBalance`) | The same s

ervice DSH itself uses; the widget only formats the numbers |
| Pricing period | Host route `/usage-
widget/api/pricing` | Host fetches the public DeepSeek Models & Pricing page daily; a public holiday

calendar is best-effort |
| Platform usage link | DSH account state (`links.usageUrl`) | Only `http

:` / `https:` URLs are rendered; opens with `noopener noreferrer` |
| Current model | DSH's `modelSe
lection` conversation projection | Read locally; not uploaded |
- The client makes **no external network requests** and stores **nothing** (no localStorage, cookies

, files or credentials).
- The host module fetches only `api-docs.deepseek.com` (pricing page) and `

timor.tech` (Chinese holiday calendar) to build the pricing-period badge; no account data is sent.
-
It reads **no API keys or account credentials**; profile fields (email, phone) are never requested
o API keys or account credentials**; profile fields (email, phone) are never requested or displayed.
See SECURITY.md for the full security notes.
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | What to check |
| Badge missing after install/update | Fully quit DSH and reopen (not just refresh). Check Settings

→ Plugins that `@mark.zy/usage-widget` is enabled. |
| Badge shows a dash | Not signed in, or the ac

count service is unavailable. |
| Balance is stale | The panel refreshes on open and every 60 second

s; the platform may lag behind real spending. |
| Text is amber | The balance is below the low-balan
ce threshold (see above). |
## Design notes
- Appends to `sidebar.footer.action` and `shell.overlay`; it never replaces the account button or th

e composer controls.
- Context pressure and token usage stay in the Harness-owned composer UI; this

plugin deliberately does not duplicate them.
- Initialization and every slot registration are error-
isolated, and the plugin does not use `immediately: true`.

Or disable/remove it in Settings → Plugins.

。
- **说明**：上下文占用和 token 用量由 DSH 自带的输入框下方指标显示，本插件不再重复。
